works.body: Good evening, I really like Wan-ko-san's illustrations and would like to place a commission. I'd like to request an illustration of Inu-desu-san and Wan-ko-san indoors. I'd like an illustration where Wan-ko-san looks happy holding a small moon in their hand, while Inu-desu-san looks into a cup, and inside the cup is a liquid-like universe spreading out.

I am getting married to someone by chance.
Doggies have healed and encouraged me in the past, so I would like them to celebrate with me this time as well.
I would like to see the two of them dressed up in Western-style costumes, and the doggies celebrating with a rice shower or something like that,
We would like you to draw such a lively illustration.
Since the wedding will be held in the summer, we would like to have an image of the entrance of the wedding hall in the midst of green trees.
We would appreciate it if you could print out the illustration in the size of a vertical poster and hang it on the wall.
Thank you in advance.

わんこさんこんにちは！
この度はアイコンを描いていただきたく、リクエストを送らせていただきました。

全体は明るめのグリーンのイメージで、メガネをかけたねこさんをお願いしたいです！よろしくお願いいたします。

Request an Icon
Features
Sky blue
Eyewear (round and big)
Upper body suit and tie
But he is holding a pancake.
And please, please, please...

I'm new to this, so I'm not sure what to expect, but this is a good opportunity for me to ask you for an icon picture.
I don't know what my image is except for a pig, so I'd appreciate it if you could do something like that for me.

Thank you very much for your wonderful illustrations last time.
I would like to request another illustration from you.
May I ask for an illustration with a realistic head after a long time?
I would like to ask you to illustrate two girls.

One girl, rather large for a woman. She has very large, beautiful gray wings on her back, but she has both confidence and anxiety about flying, and has not yet been able to fly or has never flown.
Another girl, a rather small girl. The girl has small, white wings on her back that would be very difficult to fly. But she is not pessimistic about her inability to fly, and believes in doing only what she can now. She is cheerful and doesn't care that she can't fly with her wings.
I would like an illustration of the little winged girl holding the hand of the big winged girl who was sitting on the gym and crying because she was scared, and trying to make her stand up, or trying to force her up from her sitting position and start running.

If you are too busy, you may refuse my request.
メイドさんたちに誕生日を祝ってもらうわんこがみたいです！

I would like to have a doggie wallpaper drawn for my PC wallpaper.
I would like to see a man and a woman couple pledging their love to each other in an amusement park at night, with Christmas lights shining brightly, while the doggies are congratulating each other.
Some are genuinely celebrating, some are flirting, some are playing regardless, some are as excited as I am...
I would like you to draw wallpapers that I would like to share and enjoy together, say as a gift for women who like pretty things.
Thank you in advance.

Good evening, Dr. Wanko.
Thank you for all your wonderful illustrations!
What I would like to request this time is an illustration of a black doggy (detective).
I would like to request an illustration of a black doggy (detective) sitting on a chair drinking tea and happily eating Christmas cake in an elegant English-style room with a fireplace.

I want to see dogs enjoying a white Christmas.

It doesn't matter how long it takes.

Good evening, Dr. Wanko.
Thank you for the wonderful illustration you drew last time. I love the warmth of your illustrations and look at them over and over again. I would like to make another request this time.
The request is for two spirit girls. The request was based on the apocalyptic idea of the Got Theory, which is highly questionable as a theory, and the image of the Yokohama Shopping Spree, which I myself like, but don't worry about this one too much.

There are two girls in the ruins.
One is a girl as red as fire, with flaming hair, a flame spirit in a dress, marrow eyebrows, three white eyes, double teeth and a face that is triumphant and powerful, as if it were gushing with life.
One is a water spirit girl in a suit of watery blue, straight-haired hair, somewhat fragile and disappearing, in an outdoor, unoccupied ruin.
The girl of fire is playing a violin, and the girl of water is playing a piano with her feet slightly submerged in the ruins.
They are playing their instruments very happily, paying no attention to the collapse of their surroundings.
They look as if they are telling us that the last sunset of the world, which will soon come to an end, was a very happy and warm time, and they are playing the instrument happily without paying any attention to the formality of playing the instrument.

I always enjoy looking at your wonderful illustrations and thumbnails.
What I would like to request this time is the scenery of SS I used to write on my personal site.

The sky is the world of the sea.
The earth is normal, but the sea floats in the sky.
Fish and whales are swimming in it. The sea, which floats in the sky like a film covering the stars, does not fall out of the atmosphere, but covers the sky. The sun's rays can be seen slightly beyond the sea.
There are two people in a grassy field.
One is a boy in white with slightly fox-eared hair. The boy is looking through a telescope into the empty sea.
One is a girl with cat ears wearing a raincoat. The girl is spreading out a picnic blanket and spreading out her lunch.

I would like you to draw a doggy wallpaper for my PC wallpaper.
The location is a park full of greenery in the city, except for some benches, and I want to draw an image of many dogs playing freely in the soft sunlight on an open lawn. I want to see dogs so energetic that they make me smile.
Thank you very much in advance.
